_about: Well-maintained, widely-installed npm packages. Used to verify npmguard does NOT raise false-positive `block` verdicts on routine installs. Numbers come from npm download stats as of early 2026.
_notes: Some of these (e.g. node-gyp consumers) legitimately ship install scripts. The corpus expects these to land at 'warn' at worst, never 'block', as long as no advisory or churn signal is present.
